headline: These Analysts Raise Their Forecasts On JPMorgan Following Better-Than-Expected Q2 Earnings
summary: JPMorgan surpassed earnings expectations for Q2, with adjusted EPS of $6.14 and managed revenue of $58.02B. Analysts raised price targets for the stock.

headline: RBC Capital Maintains Outperform on JPMorgan Chase, Raises Price Target to $370
Memory-Chip Selloff Drags Nasdaq 100 Lower, SanDisk Sinks 13%: Stock Market Today
summary: A brutal semiconductor and memory selloff dragged the Nasdaq and tech sector lower, even as soft June PPI and strong bank earnings steadied the broader tape.

headline: JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Vanguard Tokenize Real Stocks for the First Time
summary: DTCC completes its first live blockchain trades in tokenized stocks and Treasurys with JPMorgan, BlackRock and nearly 40 institutions.
